title: Model theory: is ES expressible in a decidable theory after fixing the structure of (ℕ, +, ·|_{divisors of 4Cp+1})?

title: Quadratic divisor problem (DFI): Σ τ(n) τ(n + h) and Σ τ(an + b)… the ES count as a 'twisted divisor sum along a quadratic sequence'

Pointwise-in-p control of the error is exactly the uniformity question; the literature's dependence on the coefficients is explicit enough to check.

title: ES over imaginary quadratic rings (ℤ[i], ℤ[ω]): does unit freedom make it easy?
connection: Potential-automorphy-style arguments work over extensions first.
